display.purpose: Wordmark and page titles only — Big Shoulders caps, tight leading, never body copy.

body.purpose: All UI prose and control text in Archivo at sm/base.

label.purpose: Courier Prime micro-caps for metadata keys, dates, counts, statuses.

data.purpose: Courier Prime sentence-case data: suggestion reasons, results, fine print.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Resting kraft cards. Dark scheme remaps the ink to black (rgb(0 0 0 / 0.45 / 0.8)).

shadows.name: shadow-lift
shadows.purpose: Hero tickets and hover lift on interactive cards; black-based at night.

shadows.name: eyelet-inset
shadows.purpose: The one recessive shadow — reinforcing the punched hang-tag hole.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The house curve — rise and draw animations settle like a piece laid on the bench.

motion.name: anim-rise
motion.purpose: Entrance: opacity 0→1, translateY(10px)→none, blur(6px)→0. Stagger 60ms per item, capped ~300–360ms.

motion.name: anim-page
motion.purpose: Route change breath: opacity + 6px rise on every screen mount.

motion.name: anim-draw
motion.purpose: Sparklines draw left-to-right via stroke-dashoffset with pathLength=1.

motion.name: anim-slide
motion.purpose: Indeterminate progress bar for stages that can't report a percentage.

motion.name: transition-control
motion.purpose: Default duration for color/shadow/transform transitions on controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Indigo by day, chalk by night; reads pressed when active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border:none; border-radius:var(--radius-control); background:var(--btn); color:var(--btn-ink); padding:8px 16px; font-family:var(--font-archivo),sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; font-weight:500; box-shadow:var(--shadow-card); transition:background-color .15s, box-shadow .15s, transform .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--btn-hover); box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); box-shadow:var(--shadow-card); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--copper); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Kraft chip with a hairline edge for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; border-radius:var(--radius-control); border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); padding:8px 16px; font-family:var(--font-archivo),sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; transition:border-color .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color:var(--line-strong); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--copper); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-outline:disabled { pointer-events:none; opacity:.5; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Quiet text-only action that never competes.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border:none; background:none; padding:0; font-family:var(--font-archivo),sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; color:var(--ink-muted); text-underline-offset:4px; transition:color .15s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--copper); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:4px; } .ds-btn-ghost:disabled { opacity:.5; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Surface-filled field with copper caret and copper focus border.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; border-radius:var(--radius-control); border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); padding:8px 12px; font-family:var(--font-archivo),sans-serif; font-size:0.875rem; outline:none; caret-color:var(--copper); transition:border-color .15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-faint); } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--line-strong); } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--copper); }

components.name: Toggle Pill
components.description: Category/season/occasion toggle; active state driven purely by aria attributes.
components.css: .ds-pill { border:none; border-radius:9999px; padding:4px 10px; background:var(--surface-sunk); color:var(--ink-muted); font-family:var(--font-archivo),sans-serif; font-size:0.75rem; transition:color .15s, background-color .15s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-pill:hover { color:var(--ink); } .ds-pill[aria-pressed="true"], .ds-pill[aria-current="page"] { background:var(--btn); color:var(--btn-ink); } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--copper); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Hang-tag Ticket
components.description: The signature card: kraft stock, punched eyelet, strung cord, stitch rule.
components.html:
fitr

Your wardrobe, and what belongs in it next.
components.css: .ds-ticket { position:relative; max-width:24rem; border-radius:var(--radius-card); border:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--surface); padding:28px 20px 20px; box-shadow:var(--shadow-lift); font-family:var(--font-archivo),sans-serif; } .ds-ticket-cord { position:absolute; top:-56px; left:32px; width:120px; height:56px; color:var(--line-strong); } .ds-eyelet { position:absolute; top:10px; left:44px; width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:9999px; border:3px solid var(--line-strong); background:var(--paper); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 1px rgb(39 48 74 / 0.15); } .ds-ticket-title { margin:0; font-family:var(--font-big-shoulders),sans-serif; font-weight:600; font-size:2.25rem; line-height:.96; letter-spacing:.01em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink); } .ds-stitch { margin-top:20px; height:2px; background-image:radial-gradient(circle, var(--line-strong) 1px, transparent 1.5px); background-size:8px 2px; background-repeat:repeat-x; background-position:center; } .ds-ticket-note { margin:20px 0 0; font-family:var(--font-courier),monospace; font-size:.75rem; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-muted); }

components.name: Rail Nav Item
components.description: Desktop rail row with copper stitch tick marking the live section.
components.html: TodayWardrobe
components.css: .ds-rail { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; width:14rem; padding:0 12px; background:#25324c; font-family:var(--font-archivo),sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:var(--radius-control); font-size:0.875rem; color:#a9b1c4; text-decoration:none; transition:color .15s, background-color .15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:rgba(255,255,255,.04); color:#e3ddca; } .ds-nav-item.ds-nav-active { background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); color:#f2ecda; } .ds-tick { position:absolute; left:0; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); height:16px; width:3px; border-radius:9999px; background:#dd8b57; } .ds-nav-item:not(.ds-nav-active) .ds-tick { opacity:0; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #dd8b57; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Stitch Divider
components.description: Chain-stitch rule used where a plain hr would go quiet.
components.css: .ds-stitch-rule { height:2px; background-image:radial-gradient(circle, var(--line-strong) 1px, transparent 1.5px); background-size:8px 2px; background-repeat:repeat-x; background-position:center; }

narrative.overview:
fitr is a garment worker's bench, not a wardrobe app. Every piece is a cutout hung on a kraft tag; outfits are collages laid out on indigo canvas; a missing piece in an outfit is a repair waiting to happen. The category-default arrangement it refuses is the neutral white-grid wardrobe app. Light theme is the unbleached workshirt in daylight; dark theme is the same bench at night, and both schemes are first-class.

Density is calm and phone-first. The daily screen answers one question with one ticket and two riveted buttons; everything else waits quietly in panels of kraft card stock separated from the woven canvas ground by hairlines. The world speaks through materials rather than ornament: punched eyelets, strung cords, chain-stitch rules, typed shipping labels. Copper thread appears only where attention is earned — focus, selection, active state, a falling price.
keyCharacteristics: Woven canvas ground under everything (two hairline threads at the edge of perception)
Kraft tag cards (--surface, 12px radius) that are never the same color as the ground
Copper as the single highlight voice: selection, caret, focus ring, active ticks, price drops
Shipping-tag typography: Big Shoulders caps for display, Archivo for UI, Courier Prime for typed data
Soft two-step shadow vocabulary (rest / lift); depth mostly comes from sunk wells and hairlines
Dashed hairline borders mean "waiting" — drop zones, outfit gaps, empty states

rules.name: The Two Cloths Rule
rules.body: --surface is never the same as --paper. Cards are tags lying *on* the canvas; if they matched the ground the bench would disappear.

rules.name: The Never-Bare-Ground Rule
rules.body: Garment cutouts never sit on the page ground or on bare --paper; images live in sunk wells (--surface-sunk), the dark well (#14130f), or the QA checker (ground-check). White garments vanish otherwise — this is functional, not taste.

rules.name: The Copper Thread Rule
rules.body: Copper marks attention exactly once per moment and in small doses: a focus ring, a caret, a tick, a badge, a falling line. It is never a background field, never body text, never two competing marks in one view.

rules.name: The Indigo-Day-Chalk-Night Rule
rules.body: The primary button inverts across schemes: indigo fill with cream text by day, chalk fill with navy text by night. Both read as "the pressed stamp" on their ground.

rules.name: The Shipping-Tag Rule
rules.body: Anything typed — labels, prices, dates, counts, statuses, machine output — sets in Courier Prime, usually with tabular numerals. Archivo carries prose; Courier carries data. They don't swap jobs.

rules.name: The Quiet-Caps Rule
rules.body: Uppercase belongs to two voices only: Big Shoulders display stamps, and tracked Courier micro-labels. Body copy never shouts.

rules.name: The Rest-and-Lift Rule
rules.body: Surfaces rest at --shadow-card and rise to --shadow-lift only as a response — hover on a match/watch row, or genuine hero status. Nothing floats at rest; nothing uses hard offset shadows.

rules.name: The Dashed-Means-Waiting Rule
rules.body: A dashed border always marks a hole to be filled: photo drop zones, outfit gap specs, empty-state panels. Solid borders mean finished things; dashed means "not yet".

dos: Do compose controls from src/lib/ui.ts (btnPrimary, btnOutline, btnGhost, btnTag, inputClass, pillClass) — never restyle a button ad hoc.
Do put every garment cutout in a sunk well, the dark well, or ground-check — never on --paper or --page ground.
Do use .display, .label, .nums, .stitch, .eyelet before writing bespoke type or divider styles.
Do mark active states with aria-pressed / aria-current so the single global pill rule applies.
Do enter with animate-rise (stagger 60ms, cap ~360ms) and route-change with animate-page; reduced-motion is handled globally and must stay that way.
Do draw any new icon in the house construction: 24px box, 1.5 stroke, round caps and joins, no fill, currentColor, defaulting to size-4.
Do check every screen in both schemes — the button inversion and rail constancy are load-bearing.
donts: Don't invent colors outside the token set; the rail's literal hexes are grandfathered to that one surface.
Don't let copper become a field, a heading color, or more than one competing mark in a view.
Don't use emoji or icon-font glyphs; they break the single icon construction.
Don't introduce new radii beyond 12px, 10px, 4px, and full-round.
Don't draw solid <hr> dividers where a stitch rule belongs, and never use dashed borders for finished things.
Don't add hard offset shadows, gradient text, kicker/eyebrow labels, or system display faces — none are part of this system.
Don't pull in a chart library for sparklines or a component library for controls.
